MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt']
WITH p.position AS position, AVG(CAST(date_diff('day', CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE), DATE('2026-10-14')) AS DOUBLE) / 365.2425) AS average_age
RETURN position AS col1, average_age AS col2
